newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts DSP Comms.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS cuts DSP Comms.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it downgraded its rating on DSP Communications Inc to buy from strong buy.
-- Late Wednesday DSP Communications said it expects earnings and revenues for its second quarter will be materially below first quarter levels.
-- In a report UBS analyst Jeffrey Schlesinger said the situation was "not as bad as it looks."
-- Cited near-term uncertainty as to product transition, but said 1998 opportunity remains "excellent."
